summary: Completed testing of Task Dependencies UI feature. All core functionality working correctly: Dependencies section in task detail modal, add/remove blocked_by and blocks tasks via dropdowns, blocked indicator (orange border in Kanban, orange badge in List view), and blocked indicator disappears when blocking task is marked as done. Backend: 13/15 tests passed (2 minor failures on dedicated /dependencies endpoint which is not used by frontend).

minor.issue: Query parameter handling for list types (blocked_by, blocks) doesn't work correctly - returns 200 but doesn't update. Frontend uses PUT /api/tasks/{id} with body instead, which works correctly.
